meta.parties: Valliammai Atchi v. Abdul Majeed, O.L.M

rules.statement: Courts can apply equitable principles to establish a trust even when the transaction is documented, and may fasten on an individual who obtained title under such a document a personal obligation if it appears that they acted fraudulently.
rules.supporting_quote: "It has been pointed out that both these decisions may be regarded as obiter dicta, but even so, I do not think that it is open to us to minimize the weight of these pronouncements. It is, however. I think, competent for me to point out that in neither of these cases was the question whether parol evidence was admissible to prove u trust considered."
